label: PF Backlog 398
title: PFSSOT-P6: minimal worker registry (+heartbeat, capability, lifecycle)
body: Doc docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md §15/§16/§19/§20/§39 Phase 6. Smallest registry: register/heartbeat/status/capabilities/unregister-or-revoke; runtime-neutral; scheduler owns authoritative worker state. Use existing PF identity if present. Gate: a worker can connect/disconnect without changing scheduler code.
